values: 一名沉稳坚韧的坦克，擅长在利用护盾保护友军。
A steadfast Tank, masterfully wielding his shield to defend his allies with unwavering strength.
No. One. Is permitted. To approach.
识别指令：收下礼物。接受指令。
Command recognized: Accept gift. Command accepted.
如今的铐兰只听从卡列琳娜的命令，似乎是因为他早已辨认不出其他人的外表与声音。
Callan only responds to Carolina these days, as he seems unable to recognize the appearance and voices of anyone else.
铐兰并非家中的独子，在所有兄弟姐妹中，他最疼爱卡列琳娜。
Callan has many siblings, but Carolina is his favorite among them.
拉季诺夫家族世代都有魔法天赋，作为家中长子，铐兰对特定的魔法领域有所涉猎，但遗憾的是，他的施法水平并不出色。
The Radinovs had possessed an innate magic talent for generations. As the eldest child of his family, Callan had explored certain branches of magic, but unfortunately, his skill was mediocre.
铐兰如今的武器是两颗巨大的实心飞锤。除了如今的他，没人能挥舞起来。
Callan wields a weapon of unimaginable weight, its power beyond the reach of any but him.
“在我们这些矮人之外，铐兰算得上是最有机械研究天赋的孩子了！唉，要是他能活到现在，肯定会是一位出色的发明家。”一个认识铐兰的矮人工匠说。

"I'd say Callan was the most gifted in machinery, aside from us dwarves! Alas, I'm sure he would have become an outstanding inventor if he had lived to this day," commented a dwarf craftsman who knew Callan.
铐兰生前的房间里收藏着很许多冒险题材的童话书，据说是准备送给妹妹的礼物。
The room Callan once stayed in housed many books about adventurous tales, which were meant as gifts for his sister.
铐兰死后的灵魂被束缚在一台机械人偶身上，而这台人偶正是他亲手制造出来，用于抵御魔物的。
After his death, Callan's soul was bound to a mechanical golem he had crafted to fend off Hypofiends.
拉季诺夫家族世代侍奉艾雅女神，是虔诚的信徒，铐兰因此得以常常出入大修道院，探望在那里进修的妹妹。
As the Radinov family had been devout followers of Dura for generations, Callan often visited the temple to see his sister, who was cultivating there.
“哥哥研究魔法的时候，经常会把自己反锁在房间里，一连好几天都不出来……他向来认真，却也很固执。”卡列琳娜回忆道。
"Every time Callan studied magic, he'd lock himself in his room for days... He took his craft seriously, but he was also quite headstrong," Carolina reminisced.
尽管铐兰一直想要解决活死人的问题，却不忍心将他们作为灵魂魔法的实验品，因此始终没有获得可观的成果。
Callan was eager to help the undead but couldn't bring himself to use them as subjects for his soul magic experiments—which is why he never achieved notable results.
